newsitem.title: USA: Supertel Hospitality names financial chief.
newsitem.headline: Supertel Hospitality names financial chief.

text.p: Supertel Hospitality Inc, which owns and operates 59 motels primarily in the Midwest and Texas, said Thursday that Troy Beatty has been named senior vice president and chief financial officer of the company, effective December 15.
Beatty succeeds Ron Boettcher who resigned to pursue other interests.
For the last three years, Beatty was the division controller of Amana Refrigeration in Amana, Iowa.
Supertel Hospitality owns and operates motels under the Super 8, Comfort Inn and Wingate Inn brand names.
Shares of Supertel Hospitality were trading up 1/4 to 9-1/4.
